title: I Took the Rec-Center Towel Card to the Desk That Issued Two to Friends

parts.text: I handed one towel card at 5:17 p.m. and the desk issued two to a friend group with no second card. The window said: ONE CARD ONE TOWEL. I was forty-five, lap swim, holding a single punch. Desk lead Ivy winked. I photographed the two towels, the one-card sign, and the unpunched friends. Ivy called it hospitality. Hospitality is a word winks use when a punch exists. I took the photo to the rec manager. Friends punch now. Ivy issues one. The stack finally looks like a card, not a party. I kept the printout in a folder labeled BORING.

social.video_title: The desk issued two towels on one missing card — Part 1/1
social.description: One-card sign, a wink, a manager still. Has hospitality ever skipped the punch?
